message: ICE arrested 50,000 people last month, apparently a record. Saw it on the news tonight.
Health insurance premiums are going up again next year, across most plans. It was on the news tonight.
There's a proposal going around to raise the tax rate on people making over $400k and put it toward childcare. It's in the news a lot.
The state legislature is voting next month on longer waiting periods and wider background checks for rifles.
The district is deciding whether to put the new money into the schools or into a voucher program families could use anywhere. Vote's next month.
City council is arguing about the police budget again — some want it bigger, some want part of it moved to mental health response.
US forces hit three Iranian oil tankers, they're saying it's a response to a missile attack. It's all over the news.
Apparently Chinese hackers got into hospitals and NASA and the Senate. That seems like a big deal?
The Canada trade talks broke down again — apparently it's stuck on dairy quotas and lumber tariffs.
Congress is voting on another aid package for Ukraine. Third one now I think.
They want to raise the defense budget again this year. Saw the number and couldn't quite believe it.
New tariffs on imported cars and steel starting next quarter. Supposed to help factories here.
